append.detail: Nine createspace.* signals (lib/create-space/signal.ts, closed props per event, never typed text) posted from the builder to its own anonymous sink app/api/create-space/signal (rate limited, exactly once per tab and event, through track() with no actor, always 204; authz ledger entry). Registered in the taxonomy server-side only. The admin Insights engagement tab shows the Create a Space funnel (visits per builder step, then launch members from every door) with the median name-to-hand-over time read from create_space_drafts' two timestamps (lib/create-space/funnel.ts). The lead score the funnel writes into signup_leads.payload flags a lead hot at 60 and up; the leads page shows the flag and lists hot leads first. There is no Frequency-level contact row for a signup lead, so the score lives on the lead row rather than contacts.meta. Probe runs signal, funnel and taxonomy tests and reads the wiring.
